sample_unit: AI chatbot platforms (each defining 3 terms, outputs rated by 6 blinded palliative care physicians)

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot palliative care definitions (Flesch Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease) versus recommended patient material levels
links.effect: Readability scores of outputs from all three platforms did not meet recommended levels for patient educational materials.
links.quote: Readability scores did not meet recommended levels for patient educational materials.

links.outcome: Reliability of references provided by chatbots, rated by physicians on 0-10 scale
links.effect: Mean reliability scores were 6.3 (2.5) for ChatGPT, 3.2 (3.1) for Bard, and 7.1 (2.4) for Bing Chat; references were often unreliable.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on their accuracy, comprehensiveness, reliability, and readability for patient-facing palliative care definitions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
